'''Mage''' is a dungeon [[class]] that specializes in dealing high Magic and area of effect damage. Most Magic Weapons have strong area of effect abilities that can clear out huge waves of mobs but in return struggle with tankier mobs such as mini bosses.

== Class Passives ==
* {{AN|Mage Staff}}: All your melee weapon attacks become ranged. Those attacks deal <math>\left(\,30%+0.9\times\frac{\color{aqua}\text{Intelligence}}{1000}\,\right)</math> of their melee [[Damage Calculation|damage]] up to {{green|10}} blocks, after which damage is reduced.
* {{AN|Efficient Spells}}: All abilities have a 25% shorter cooldown.

== Dungeon Orb Abilities ==
* {{AN|Guided Sheep}}: Shoots a Guided Sheep, dealing damage based on your Mage level! Can destroy weak walls and crypts inside a dungeon. (Cooldown: 30s)
* {{AN|Thunderstorm}}: Unleash a Thunderstorm, striking enemies in a 10 block radius for 15 seconds dealing damage based on your Mage level!

== Ghost Abilities ==
* {{AN|Instant Wall}}: Create a 5x3 wall at the block you are looking at which lasts for 10 seconds
* {{AN|Fireball}}: Shoots a fireball, dealing damage based on your Mage level!

== Leveling Rewards ==
{{/Skill UI}}

You can level up the Mage class while playing as a Mage or if you have a teammate that is a Mage, you get some of its Mage XP as a team bonus.

For every Mage level up to level 50 you get:
*+ 5 {{stat|int}}
*+ 100-2000 Guided Sheep Damage
*+ 80-1600 Fireball Damage

For every other Mage level you also get:
*+ 1% Cooldown Reduction

Every 5 Mage levels grants:
*{{Stat|Ability Damage|+1}}

At level 50 you get the following buffs:
* +250 {{statname | intelligence}}, for a total of +500 {{statname | intelligence}}
* {{Stat|Ability Damage|+10}}, for a total of {{Stat|Ability Damage|+15}}
* +25% Cooldown Reduction, for a total of -50%

== Strategies ==
Mage tactics can be categorized into the two following meta: 

Left Click Mage:  utilizes the mage beam (the mage staff passive) to do extremely high amounts of {{stat|dmg}}. This is an alternative to the Berserker class, as while you can achieve much higher numbers, mage beam is less consistent than [[berserk]]er attacks, and you also get less {{stat|ehp}}. The best Left Click Mage armors have both high {{stat|int}}, {{stat|str}}, and {{stat|cd}} (for example, [[Precursor Gear|Ancient]] [[Storm's Armor]] is very good for left click mage). The [[Dark Claymore]] and [[Midas' Sword]] with the ultimate enchantment '''[[Chimera]]''' are currently the best weapons for this play style. This is because they both have very high base damage, which when paired with the right armor, equipment and pet allows players to achieve insane amounts of damage. It is recommended to optimize for {{stat|str}} and {{stat|cd}} when getting stone powers and stats tuning for your [[accessories]]. Good pets for this play style include damage pets such as the [[Ender Dragon Pet]] and [[Golden Dragon Pet]].

Right Click Mage: Utilizes weapon abilities to deal less damage than mage beam, better suited against clusters of mobs. The best armors are either armor sets that provide good {{stat|ehp}}, like [[Necromancer Lord Armor]], or armor sets that provide a lot of {{stat|mana}}, like [[Storm's Armor]] or [[Wise Dragon Armor]]. Some weapons that can be used include [[Dreadlord Sword]] (early game), [[Bonzo's Staff]] (early-mid game), [[Frozen Scythe]] (early-mid game), [[Spirit Sceptre]] (mid game), [[Yeti Sword]] (mid game), [[Midas Staff|Midas' Staff]] (late game), [[Ice Spray Wand]] (more used for its ability which freezes all enemies as opposed to its {{stat|ability dmg}}, late-end game), and [[Hyperion]] (or Astraea for more ehp, late-end game). As for pets, both the [[Sheep Pet]] and [[Golden Dragon Pet]] increase output damage significantly with the Sheep also reducing mana consumption. It is still often recommended to use both left and right click for this strategy, as melee hits in dungeons regenerate 5 + 1% of max mana. Also, with the mana steal enchant from Enderman Slayer, melee hits can regenerate up to 5 + 1.6% of max mana. When tuning accessories, it is best to use the Inspired Power at first, but as soon as you can buy Ender Monocles for the Sighted power, buy it. The ability damage and intelligence are superior to all powers save Bizarre, which is late game due to its absurd cost.

For more information visit [[Tutorials/Mage Guide]].
